sources.title: AdamW (Adam with Decoupled Weight Decay) — An Adam Variant That ...
sources.snippet: AdamW (Adam with Decoupled Weight Decay) is an optimization algorithm that applies weight decay separately (i.e., decouples it) from Adam's gradient-based parameter update. It keeps Adam's fast and stable convergence, while avoiding the "regularization distortion" that can happen when L2-style penalties get entangled with Adam's adaptive scaling.
